name: Fast Maximum Intensity Projection (MIP)
definition: A method to accelerate Maximum Intensity Projection by decomposing the density domain into intervals and using shear-warp projection optimized for finding the maximum density along rays.
summary: Fast Maximum Intensity Projection accelerates rendering by decomposing density into intervals and using shear-warp projection to resample only where the maximum density resides, avoiding brute-force resampling.
